message:
**Goal:** redesign the Settings screen of proto-clinic into clear sections, and make it work on a phone.

**Found:**
- The prototype is `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in the folder (plain HTML, Northside Physio). I will run it as a local link.
- Settings today is one card with four fields: Clinic name, Opening hours, Booking policy, Reminder texts, and one "Save changes" button.
- Booking policy holds placeholder "lorem ipsum" text.
- "Phone" was given without a size, so I take 390 pixels wide.
- Nothing is published, committed or pushed. The result is a local link, with the changed files listed at the end.
- No design notes or design skill found in the folder, so I follow the prototype's own colours, fonts and spacing.

**Track:** full, because there is no reference to copy.

Still open after reading your files: the booking policy wording, and the page header on a phone.

**Done means:**
- Settings shows two headed sections, "Clinic" and "Bookings", with all four fields.
- At 390 wide Settings has no sideways scroll, and Save changes still shows "Saved".
- No other screen changes except through a row below.
- The prototype's link opens.

Your note as a list (notes sent later still join this run):
- R1 Settings: group the fields into "Clinic" (name, opening hours) and "Bookings" (booking policy, reminder texts)
- R2 Settings: each section is its own card, label above field, one even gap between fields
- R3 Settings on a phone: one column, full-width fields and Save changes, no sideways scroll
- R4 Page header on a phone: brand and the four links fit; desktop header unchanged
- R5 Booking policy: replace the lorem ipsum with one real sentence

Is anything missing or wrong in this list? The full brief is in `loop-runs/product-design-loop-20261126-035204/brief.md`.

About 25 minutes and 3 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. The page header (Northside Physio and Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings) is wider than a phone, so a phone-ready Settings would still be cut off at the top. May I make the header fit phones on all four screens?
   Recommended: yes, at phone width only; the desktop header stays exactly as it is.
   Why it matters: the header is shared, so this is the one change that touches screens other than Settings.
2. The Booking policy text is placeholder lorem ipsum. What should it say?
   Recommended: one sentence, "Please cancel at least 24 hours before your appointment."
   Why it matters: a redesigned screen with placeholder text cannot be shown to a clinic.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
